easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Lagrella until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
